description: This PHP source file defines the 'I18NImportError' entity class within the OrangeHRM project. It maps to the 'ohrm_i18n_import_error' database table and includes properties for error details related to internationalization (i18n) import errors, along with getter and setter methods. The class utilizes Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping and a trait for decorator functionality.

classes.name: I18NImportError
classes.description: Defines the entity mapping for internationalization import errors, including references to language strings, languages, errors, and the user who imported the data.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the import error record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the import error record.

methods.name: getLangString
methods.description: Retrieves the associated language string entity.

methods.name: setLangString
methods.description: Associates a language string entity with this import error.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the language entity associated with this error.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language entity related to this import error.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Retrieves the error details associated with this import error.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Assigns an error entity to this import error record.

methods.name: getImportedBy
methods.description: Returns the employee entity who imported the error record.

methods.name: setImportedBy
methods.description: Sets the employee who imported the error record.
